# signoz_cloud_integration_account (Resource)

Manages a SigNoz cloud integration account (`/api/v1/cloud_integrations/{cloud_provider}/accounts`). Requires ADMIN API access.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug in the API path. Valid values: `aws`, `azure`. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `config` (String) JSON account configuration (`CloudintegrationtypesPostableAccountConfig`). For AWS include `aws.deploymentRegion` and `aws.regions`; for Azure include `azure` per OpenAPI.

### Optional

- `credentials` (String, Sensitive) JSON credentials (`CloudintegrationtypesCredentials`) required on create: `sigNozApiUrl`, `sigNozApiKey`, `ingestionUrl`, `ingestionKey`. Default: omitted on update (not sent; value retained in Terraform state only). Sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `account_provider` (String) Provider slug on the account object returned by the API (e.g. `aws`, `azure`). Read-only.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Read-only.
- `provider_account_id` (String) Cloud provider account identifier (e.g. AWS account ID). Read-only.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
